column1: # Embedded-plugin manifest — the single declarative source naming which Wasm
# plugins ship inside the CLI binary. This file is read by the embedded package
# (to build its registry table) and by the embedded build, freshness-check, and
# drift-guard scripts, so the embedded set is authored exactly once and the
# parallel lists cannot drift apart.
# One row per embedded plugin. Fields are tab-separated; blank lines and lines
# beginning with # are ignored. Fields:
#   socket      plugin socket (provider, linter, ...) — first URI path segment
#   name        plugin name — second URI path segment and artifact basename
#   sourcePath  guest source directory, relative to the aggrega-cli module root
#   toolchain   guest toolchain: go or rust
#   extraRoots  comma-separated extra source roots for the freshness check
#               (e.g. a local SDK crate); empty for go guests
# The registry key is oci://hub.aggrega.ai/plugin/{socket}/{name}; the embedded
# assets are plugins/{name}.wasm.gz and plugins/{name}.describe.json.
